newsitem.title: UK: Chiroscience drug gets IND status from FDA.
newsitem.headline: Chiroscience drug gets IND status from FDA.

text.p: British drug research company Chiroscience Group Plc said on Monday it had been granted Investigational New Drug (IND) status for levobupivacaine by the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA).

Chiroscience said the approval of levobupivacaine, its long acting local anaesthetic, means that a series of U.S. trials will begin as planned in January 1997, starting with a Phase III trial in epidural Caesarian section.
Trials in infiltration shoulder surgery, juvenile epidural surgery, post-operative pain control and cancer pain control will begin during the following three months, it said.
It said the first European registration application was planned for late 1997.
By 1019 GMT, shares in the company had risen 9-1/2p to stand at 327-1/2.
